evidence.original_label: 皮秒激光划片设备 产品优势 加工效率高 UPH≥10
evidence.excerpt: 产品优势 ｜ 加工效率高 ｜ UPH≥10 （紫外振镜：以3英寸双台面硅二极管晶圆为例，含自动对位时间）

notes: Vendor product page for HG Laser's 皮秒激光划片设备 (models LUD3200 / LUD3210), described as 采用紫外皮秒激光器，针对硅和化合物半导体晶圆进行精密半切或全切 — unambiguous wafer dicing, so dicing_laser. The source writes UPH (units per hour) and states the reference workpiece as a 3英寸双台面硅二极管晶圆 including auto-alignment time, so the unit is wafers per hour on that stated 3-inch example and must not be read as a throughput for any other wafer size. A lower bound (≥), preserved as relation ge. Locator 1 is this single archived HTML document, not a PDF page. The page carries no publication date, so the period is collapsed to the 2026-09-24 archive date, which is the only date the atlas can attest; it is not a disclosure period.

evidence.original_label: 第二代国产化高端晶圆激光切割设备 整体效率提升了 20%
evidence.excerpt: 2024年三季度，华工科技在第一代高端晶圆激光切割装备的基础上再次升级，推出了第二代国产化高端晶圆激光切割设备。该设备重点针对软件自动化运行进行了技术改进与升级，通过企业自研的半导体切割软件与算法，使其整体效率提升了20%。

notes: Issuer-stated design gain of HG Laser's second-generation 高端晶圆激光切割装备 against its own first generation, the baseline the source names. It is a product-design efficiency gain attributed to self-developed semiconductor dicing software and algorithms, not measured customer output and not factory capacity. The source dates the second-generation launch to 2024 Q3, which is the period used; the document itself was published 2025-02-07. Locator 1 is this single archived HTML document, not a PDF page. The neighbouring claim 切割效率较传统刀轮切割提高 5 倍 is held: its baseline is a competing technology, not the tool's own design baseline, and the metric's unit vocabulary is percent only.
